text:
natalie_ar: FYI  Solari (vendor) processed a refund to ACME Labs twice for the same disputed overcharge. Net duplicate refund = $7,500. Need vendor-side reversal or we need to post an internal receivable.

omar_recon: Can you paste invoice/ref numbers so AR can match?

natalie_ar: Sure, redacted excerpt below:

``
Customer: ACME Labs
Orig Invoice: INV-2026-0552
Refund 1: REF-2026-298 (issued 2026-05-02) - $7,500
Refund 2: REF-2026-299 (issued 2026-05-02) - $7,500 (duplicate)
Net refunded: $15,000 (should have been $7,500)
Vendor invoice credited: VINV-2026-122 (Solari)
AR ledger shows negative outstanding for ACME until we apply a correcting debit.
```

sam_sales: This is the channel partner account we're co-selling with; CC their AM. We should ask Solari to reverse the duplicate refund and supply a vendor credit memo referencing VINV-2026-122.

lena_cs: ACME reached out confused about the extra refund hitting their bank. They want it reversed or they'll return funds, but we need vendor confirmation to avoid accounting churn.

omar_recon: Root cause on our side?

trent_fin: Also need GL mapping and approval. If vendor issues a reversing credit, we post to 5100-ADJ (Vendor Adjustments). If we end up collecting the funds back from ACME (customer returns funds), that'll be contra-revenue 4001-REV adjustment. If vendor refuses, we may need to temporarily record an intercompany receivable 1200-IC until resolved.

natalie_ar: I reached out to Solari AP with draft language: "We identified a duplicate refund REF-2026-299 issued to ACME Labs on 2026-05-02 against VINV-2026-122. Requesting reversal/refund of $7,500 or issuance of a debit note so we can reconcile our AR. Please confirm by EOD 5/7 with expected timeline."

billing-bot: Created audit ticket AT-2026-4412. Draft adjustment ADJ-2026-270 created, status: pending-vendor-response. Linked documents: INV-2026-0552, REF-2026-298, REF-2026-299, VINV-2026-122.

omar_recon: Engineering note: we observed a race in the refund webhook delivery on 2026-05-02 which caused Solari's system to receive two identical events. We patched our outbound webhook retry debounce at 2026-05-03 03:15 UTC. Logged in incident AT-2026-4412.

trent_fin: Approving provisional GL routing: set ADJ-2026-270 to 5100-ADJ pending vendor credit. If no vendor remediation in 14 days, escalate to CFO for decision on booking 1200-IC vs writing to 5901-EXC.

sam_sales: Please ask Solari to include a short confirmation note that they reversed REF-2026-299 or will issue a debit note. Need that for ACME and audit. Also ask for expected settlement date.

natalie_ar: Will update vendor note to request settlement ETA and confirmation text. Sending now and CC-ing lena_cs and omar_recon.

lena_cs: Thanks. I'll inform ACME that we're coordinating with Solari and will keep them updated; don't want them to initiate a manual return without vendor ack.

billing-bot: ADJ-2026-270 updated: awaiting-vendor-ack. Reminder set for escalation in 14 days.

trent_fin: Documenting approval here. If Solari issues a debit note, AR to apply and post to 5100-ADJ. If Solari refunds us cash and ACME returns funds, AR to process customer return against INV-2026-0552 and route revenue impact per 4001-REV.

natalie_ar: Closing loop will post vendor reply and next steps once received.
